messages:
Zoe (Partnerships): HelioForge sent their marketplace bundle and a hardware appliance badge request. Need logo fallbacks, a short co-authorship blurb, and legal on a hardware partnership claim.
Dana (Partner Ops): Files uploaded: https://drive.redwood/partners/helioforge/hw_marketplace_0726. Includes: helio_logo.svg, helio_lockup_guidelines.pdf, helio_case_ibex.pdf, helio_appliance_badge.ai, helio_brand_colors.sketch
Riley (Design): Opening the guide  primary issue: Helio uses a metallic sheen and angled bevel. Marketplace prohibits bevel/glow. Need a flat SVG and a monochrome badge for small sizes. Also their lockup requires vertical stacking for compact tiles; that's unusual but doable if spacing is clear.
Marcus (PMM): For marketplace copy they proposed: "HelioForge + Redwood: certified on-prem appliance"  the word "certified" implies endorsement. We should avoid that unless our Solutions Eng confirms hardware compatibility. Suggest: "HelioForge + Redwood: on-prem inference appliance integration."
Fiona (Legal): On the case study, the quote references a named customer and a benchmark. I need the signed consent and confirmation that Helio has rights to publish benchmark claims. If they claim "certified" we need evidence of our testing.
Dana (Partner Ops): I see `ibex_release_signed_2026.pdf` and `helio_hw_test_report.pdf` in the folder. Uploaded by Helio PM at 07:18.
Riley (Design): I can export `helio_badge_flat.svg` and `helio_badge_mono.png`, plus `helio_thumbnail_16x9_v1.jpg` with vertical lockup. Will include README snippet: "No bevels, no shadows; use flat fallback for icons <=32px." ETA 2h.
OpsBot: Task created: verify-hw-compatibility assigned to @SolutionsEng, due in 72h
Marcus (PMM): For the co-author blurb, propose two options: 1-line: "In partnership with HelioForge" 2-line: "HelioForge appliance\nIntegrated with Redwood Inference." Both factual.
Fiona (Legal): Reviewing `ibex_release_signed_2026.pdf` now. If Helio's test report includes our name and results, Legal will want a statement that we ran/validated those tests or a disclaimer if data is partner-provided.
Dana (Partner Ops): Helio also asked to display a "Works on HelioForge Appliance" hardware badge next to the logos. Policy: we can include a partner-provided hardware badge only after Solutions Eng confirms compatibility. Pending.
Zoe (Partnerships): Ok, we should prepare publish assets without the hardware badge and toggle it on later if Solutions Eng signs off. Use conservative copy for now; no "certified" language.
Riley (Design): Adding `helio_alt_text_en.md` and `helio_readme_usage.md` with the spacing rule (vertical lockup, 28px clearspace) and accessibility notes (contrast variants).
Marcus (PMM): I'll update the marketplace copy to: "HelioForge + Redwood: on-prem appliance integration for inference." Uploading as `partner-helioforge-copy_v1.txt`.
Fiona (Legal): Quick update: `ibex_release_signed_2026.pdf` gives permission to reuse the quote for marketing and marketplaces but the benchmark numbers are partner-supplied. Legal OK to use quote with attribution; add disclaimer in README: "Benchmark figures provided by HelioForge; Redwood did not independently verify unless Solutions Eng confirms."
Dana (Partner Ops): Noted. I'll create `alt_text_locales/placeholder.txt` so Helio can add localizations later.
Riley (Design): Exports uploaded with naming convention: `partner-helioforge-badge_flat.svg`, `partner-helioforge-badge_mono.png`, `partner-helioforge-thumbnail_v1.jpg`.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: publish-ready-review in 24h for partners/helioforge/thread/2101112222
Zoe (Partnerships): Final checklist: 1) flat/mono badges (Riley)  done 2) alt text + README (Riley)  done 3) conservative copy file (Marcus)  done 4) legal clause re: benchmarks (Fiona)  done 5) hardware badge pending Solutions Eng (OpsBot)
Marcus (PMM): When Solutions Eng confirms compatibility we can swap the copy to include the "Works on HelioForge Appliance" mention. For now, publish with no hardware badge.
Fiona (Legal): I'll upload the one-line legal snippet to the README: "HelioForge-provided benchmark figures; Redwood requires Solutions Eng validation to endorse."
Dana (Partner Ops): Pinged Solutions Eng for the hardware check. They acknowledged the task.
Zoe (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll close the loop after Solutions Eng reply and partner final approval. :thumbsup:
